A6 AXI4 Ordering Model
                                                                                                      A6.2 Master ordering


A6.2    Master ordering

            A master that issues multiple transactions in the same direction, read or write, with the same ID has the following
                     guarantees about the ordering of these transactions:

                          •    The order of response at the master to all transactions must be the same as the order of issue.

                          •     For transactions to Device memory, the order of arrival at the slave must be the same as the order of issue.

                          •     For Normal memory, the order of arrival at the slave of transactions to the same or overlapping addresses,
                        must be the same as the order of issue. This applies also, to transactions to cacheable memory. That is, it
                             applies to all valid transactions for which AxCACHE[3:1] is not 0b000.
